header.title: How to Replace a Refrigerator Seal
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to replace a refrigerator door seal (gasket) to improve energy efficiency and prevent air leaks. It covers removing the old gasket, cleaning, installing the new one, and ensuring a proper seal.

steps.description: Remove the old refrigerator gasket by carefully prying it away from the door after loosening any fasteners.
actions: Prepare a flathead screwdriver for prying.
Loosen fasteners or screws.
Pry the gasket away from the door carefully.
Save any fasteners.
Place fasteners in a bowl.
Cover fasteners with baking soda.
Pour white vinegar over the fasteners.
Allow fasteners to soak.
Rinse fasteners well in water.

steps.description: Clean the inside of the door after removing the old gasket, using appropriate cleaning agents based on the level of grime or mold present.
actions: Give the inside of the door a good cleaning.
Use vinegar and water for cleaning.
Use a de-greaser if there's a lot of built-up gunk.
Use a toothbrush and bleach to clean mold.
Dry the area well when finished.

steps.description: Straighten the new gasket by laying it in the sun, pulling it straight, or using heat to increase its flexibility before installation.
actions: Straighten the gasket
Lay the gasket in the sun
Pull the gasket straight
Lay the gasket on your car hood
Lay the gasket on the deck
Place the gasket in hot water

steps.description: Install the new gasket onto the door, starting from the center and working towards the corners, ensuring a tight fit.
actions: Start installing the new gasket in the center at the top of the door.
Press the gasket in.
Fasten the gasket with screws or other fasteners.
Work your way toward each corner.
Ensure there are no gaps or twists.
Pull the gasket back out if there are gaps or twists.
Start over if there are gaps or twists.
Finish pushing and fastening the gasket down the sides.
Finish pushing and fastening the gasket along the bottom.
Ensure the gasket is completely installed.

steps.description: Verify the gasket installation by checking door closure and seal integrity, and tighten fasteners if necessary.
actions: Close the doors
Ensure that they shut properly
Check for any gaps in the seal
Go back over all your fasteners or screws
Make sure they are properly tightened

steps.description: Apply mineral, lemon, or olive oil to the new gasket to prevent drying and cracking, and maintain it with regular cleaning and oiling.
actions: Rub the entire new gasket down with mineral oil, lemon oil, or olive oil.
Wash down the gasket with bleach water once a month.
Dry the gasket.
Wipe the gasket with oil (not too much).
